module.name: Cisco SIP Manager
module.description: Provisioning of Cisco SIP phones (79xx/88xx) for chan_sip: SEP*.cnf.xml generation, AnyConnect VPN profile (ocserv), LAN/VPN registration status and remote actions (restart, XML messages).
module.changelog: *17.7.0* UI follows the FreePBX language (gettext): English and Spanish included *17.6.8* Edit phone in a dialog over the list *17.6.7* Per-phone Enable video option (8845/8865, 8851/8861 with USB camera) *17.6.6* callLogBlfEnabled according to the model (1 on 88xx, 3 on 79xx) *17.6.5* Restart all and Reboot all buttons in the Phones tab *17.6.4* Backgrounds: thumbnails and paths read from List.xml (Cisco backgrounds), existing entries are kept *17.6.3* Default ringtone lists RingList.xml and RingList-wb.xml *17.6.2* Ringtones in Ringlist.xml (.raw) and Ringlist-wb.xml (.rwb, 88xx) *17.6.1* Ringtone list as RingList.xml (configurable), limits of 50 ringtones and 25 characters *17.6.0* Remote control, dialing, display on for notices, inventory, VPN sessions, bulk actions, key/background/ringtone editors *17.5.0* View screen (/CGI/Screenshot) with automatic refresh *17.4.0* Template based on a working 88xx SEP; Auto location with VPN+LAN servers and autoNetDetect; extra XML replaces elements; versionStamp *17.3.0* Import of existing SEP files without overwriting them; additional lines; compare with what would be generated *17.2.0* Global CAPF block (capfAuthMode, empty password by default, and capfList) *17.1.0* SEP version history with diff and restore; Backup & Restore integration *17.0.3* Defaults: SIP over TCP, VPN by certificate *17.0.2* Fixes VPN authMethod, 79x5 without VPN, configurable SIP transport *17.0.1* First version
